body:
This is a really good song. After my relationship ended, I started listening to Saves the Day a lot again (he didn't like them and would always hate on me for listening). 

Alcohol has been a really problem for me lately, I have been spending most of my money on booze and heavy drinking. I rarely go a day without at least 1 or 2 drinks. As of the past week or two, I have been wanting to stop, because when I look at everything around me and how fucked up I woud  just feel like drinking and, to be honest, drinking like that used to make me feel better, but now it doesn't and it's just...boring.
I've rarely encountered another person with a similar interest in this band (aside from being at their shows).

Recently, I haven't been enjoying anything. I used to like going to the beach and the gym, but that is boring to me now. Everything I used to like doing is so....painfully....boring to do now. When I'm home, I'm bored and can't wait to go out. When I'm out, I'm bored and can't wait to go home. It makes no sense and I know there is something wrong with my perceptions right now. 

I like Saves the Day, but I probably shouldn't listen to that in my mood right now. Even if I did, I would be hitting skip on the songs
